text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp, returning after a 
full year. Another season of dedicated 
training to hone their skills begins.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Her future plans were still undecided. 
Even so, Hishi Akebono seemed ready to 
enjoy this summer without worrying too 
much.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a promise secured to see the 
fireworks display, the hot summer training 
camp kicked off!
